## Offline coding of Familiarization phase
Labs not using an eye tracker and/or running a fixed-length design will need to code infant looking time during the familiarization phase. 


## Offline coding of Test phases
ALL labs, regardless of aparatus or design, will need to code infant looking time during the two test phases of each trial.
